info.name: Sovrn Commerce Product Promo Codes API

params.name: api_key
params.description: Site API key for the site requesting coupons.

params.name: product_url
params.description: Original retailer product page URL. Must not be an affiliate or redirect URL.

params.name: include_unverified
params.description: Whether to include unverified coupon codes after verified results. Defaults to true.

params.name: cuid
params.description: Custom identifier used to associate the click with a user, page, campaign, or event.

params.name: utm_source
params.description: Identifies the source of the traffic (e.g., website, newsletter, twitter).

params.name: utm_medium
params.description: Identifies the marketing medium (e.g., email, social, banner).

params.name: utm_campaign
params.description: Identifies the campaign name, promotion, or initiative.

params.name: utm_term
params.description: Identifies paid search keywords or targeting terms.

params.name: utm_content
params.description: Differentiates similar links or placements on the same page.

items.docs: Returns verified and unverified coupon codes for a specific product URL, along with merchant information and verification status.
